text: Program Description 1. Program Description Editor Notes: This program aims to train international medical health care service talents. This program will refer to international standards for medical education, mainly aiming at cultivating internationally universal medical practitioner with substantial medical preclinical knowledge, normative clinical skills & favorable professional quality, taking international requests of source countries of international students the requests of the students to return to their motherland to serve other country into appropriate accounts, allowing the graduates to become practitioner to offer service of medical treatment, education research in medical health care service sectors. Lectures of this major will be given in English all the way to top students of all countries in the world who aspire to study research medical science. Graduates may participate in the Examination of Doctors Qualifications as per the relevant rules of the countries after graduation. 2. Major courses Editor Notes: This program will provide different kinds of courses for international students. Systematic Anatomy, Biochemistry, Physiology, Pathology, Pharmacology, Microbiology, Preventive medicine, Evidence-based Medicine, Diagnostics, Introduction to Surgery, Internal Medicine, Surgery, Obstetrics & Gynecology, Pediatrics, Infectious Diseases, Neurology, Psychiatry, Medical Ethics, Chinese, etc. 3. University Size Editor Notes: Now GXMU has 5 affiliated hospitals and 11 11 Non-directly Administrated Affiliated Hospitals. Currently,GXMU has five affiliated hospitals under its direct administration. Among them, the first Affiliated Hospital, the Affiliated Tumor Hospital and the Hospital of Stomatology are the largest"Grade 3 Class A" hospital in Guangxi.They play a leading rolein higher medical education,medical scientific research and health services in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. GXMU has 11 Non-directly Administrated Affiliated Hospitals in 7 major cities of Guangxi.These hospitals are the largest hospitals in these cities and they are also teaching hospitals of GXMU. 4. Scientific Research Innovation Editor Notes: GXMU has advantages in scientific research and has won fund project and grants. GXMU has advantages in the researches on common diseases and frequently-occuring diseases in Guangxi and reached the international advanced level, such as prevention and treatment of regional high-incidence tumor, prevention and treatment of thalassernia,hemoglobin research,snake venom research,prevention and treatment of cardiovascular disease,drug research,liver transplantation,finger repantation,perlpheral blood stem cell transplantation,etc. Since the 11th Five-Year Plan,GXMU has won one National Key R&D project,one National Social Science Fund project, and has won grants from the National Science Foundation of China for 808 research projects,ranking in the forefront of universities in Guangxi. Researchers of GXMU have published 3079 SCI papers in top internatiinal journals such as New England Journal of Medicine, Nature Biotechnology and Nature Genetics as the first author or correspondent.More than 270 projects have won National Science and Technology Award,Ministry of Education Science and Technology Award,Guangxi Science and Technology Progress Award and Guangxi Science Award. 5. Joint Degree Program Editor Notes: GXMU will provide more and more joint degree program in the near future. In 2013, the joint bachelor's degree program in Information Management and Information Systemin collaboration with Western Oregon University,USA was approved by the Education Department of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. In 2014, the joint bachelor's degree program in Public Service Administration in collaboration with Western Oregon University,USA was approvedby the Ministry of Education. 6. University Brief Introduction Editor Notes: Guangxi Medical University is recognized by the WHO. Guangxi Medical University (GXMU), founded in 1934, is one of the 22 oldest medical institutes in China and one of the first 8 qualified to enroll international students. It is located in a border city-Nanning, capital of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. The school covers an area of 98.8 acres and enrolls 8,800 students. Beginning in 1978, international education in GXMU has become rather mature and complete. Currently, more than 300 foreign students from Vietnam, Indonesia, Nepal, India, Africa, Oceania, Europe, and the United States are studying here. The Clinical Medicine in Chinese was set up in 1978, and the English-medium program started in 2001. GXMU has rich experiences in medical education. And, there were graduates for years; the average rate of acquiring Medical License is 90%. In 2008, the English-medium MBBS program is recognized by MOE as the first batch of qualified universities. Now it recruits about 700 international students from India, Nepal, Vietnam, Indonesia, Mauritius, and Sri Lanka, etc. GXMU is recognized by WHO and the graduates of MBBS program are eligible to take the Medical Licensing Examinations held by the medical councils in different countries such as MCI, PMDC, USMLE, HPCSA, SCHS, etc. Learn More>> 7.Campus Life Editor Notes: Students will have a wonderful campus life in GXMU.
